name: mcode-webui
description: Browser-based chat frontend for the mcode agent runtime. v2.0.0 industrializes the v1.x surface with append-only event stream + hash chain, independent anomaly SSE channel, per-request authorize() gate, interaction/feedback subsystem split, plugin metadata drift detector, local SBOM + CVE gates, rate limiting, virtual chat list, cross-workspace session search, session export (Markdown / JSON), quota forecast, and token-onboarding modal. Zero npm dependencies; runs on Node 22+.

extensions.securityNotes: See references/SECURITY-NOTES.md — canonical disclosure (loopback bind default with explicit LAN opt-in, trusted-origin CORS, ?token= query, mavis sqlite cross-delete, bounded file upload, workspace containment, no telemetry). Per red-line 7 of mcode-plugin-guide, this is the single source of truth.

HOST.description: HTTP bind address. Default is loopback 127.0.0.1; LAN exposure is explicit opt-in — set HOST (e.g. 0.0.0.0) or the persisted lanBind setting (POST /api/settings {lanBind: true}, restart-effective)

TOKEN.description: Required token for non-local requests (use ?token= or Authorization: Bearer)

MCODE_WEBUI_UPLOAD_MAX_REQUEST.description: Max total upload request body in bytes (default 50 MiB, positive integer; over-limit requests get 413)

MCODE_WEBUI_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE.description: Max single uploaded file in bytes (default 25 MiB, positive integer; over-limit requests get 413)

MCODE_WEBUI_UPLOAD_QUOTA.description: Total size cap for the upload directory in bytes (default 200 MiB, positive integer; over-limit requests get 413)

MCODE_WEBUI_WORKSPACE_ROOTS.description: Allowed roots for workspace containment, separated by the platform path separator (: on POSIX, ; on Windows). Unset = default set (user home + default workspace + system tmp). Setting it fully replaces the default set

capabilities.name: chat-streaming
capabilities.description: Streams model output token-by-token from the mcode acp subprocess via Server-Sent Events (`GET /api/events`). Each delta event includes `text` and `isPartial` so the browser can render progressive assistant replies without buffering the full response.

capabilities.name: tool-execution
capabilities.description: Forwards Bash, Read, Write, Edit, and other tool-call events from the mcode acp JSON-RPC stream to the chat UI. Tool output auto-collapses on completion; per-tool permission prompts are surfaced as a modal (see `permission-prompts`).

capabilities.name: plan-mode
capabilities.description: Adds a `Plan:` prefix to the prompt so the mcode acp subprocess emits a structured plan event. The webui renders a plan-review modal with options (`agree` / `skip` / `add context`) and forwards the choice via `POST /api/answer`.

capabilities.name: ask-user-tool
capabilities.description: Renders the mcode acp `ask_user` event as a modal question with 2-4 options, optional multi-select checkboxes, and a free-text 'Other' field. Answer is sent back through `POST /api/send` with `isAskAnswer: true`.

capabilities.name: permission-prompts
capabilities.description: When the mcode subprocess requests approval for a tool call, the webui opens a permission modal with three options (`ask` / `auto` / `full`). The user's choice is forwarded via `POST /api/answer {type: 'permission', option}`.

capabilities.name: workspace-switching
capabilities.description: Workspace picker backed by `POST /api/workspace` and `GET /api/workspace/browse`. Recents list persists in `localStorage`; the last-used workspace is restored on reload. Per-workspace git status (branch / dirty) is shown best-effort.

capabilities.name: session-management
capabilities.description: List, create, switch, and delete webui sessions via `/api/sessions`. Deleting a session also cross-deletes the linked mcode row from `~/.minimax/v2/sqlite/runtime-state.sqlite` in a single transaction. Pass `?dryRun=true` to preview.

capabilities.name: file-attachments
capabilities.description: Upload files via `POST /api/upload` (multipart), saved to `MCODE_WEBUI_UPLOAD_DIR`. Drag-and-drop, click-to-upload, and Ctrl+V paste are wired in the chat UI. The server injects `@absolute-path` references into the prompt.

capabilities.name: quota-usage
capabilities.description: Displays `mmx quota show` data (remaining quota, time-until-reset for the 5-hour and weekly windows) plus per-turn `lastTurnContextTokens` read from the mavis runtime sqlite. Refreshes silently every 2 minutes or on demand via the 'refresh' button.

capabilities.name: bilingual-ui
capabilities.description: All user-visible strings go through `I18N.zh` / `I18N.en` lookup tables with `t(key)`. The locale toggle in the top-bar switches the entire UI; 22+ keys were added in v1.0.1 for the LAN settings sub-card.

capabilities.name: lan-sharing
capabilities.description: Binds loopback `127.0.0.1:8080` by default; LAN exposure is an explicit opt-in — the `HOST` env var or the persisted `lanBind` setting (`POST /api/settings {lanBind: true}`, effective on restart). A runtime toggle (`POST /api/settings {lanBroadcast: false}`) additionally closes the LAN gate with a bilingual 403 page. The settings snapshot discloses the live exposure via `lanExposed` / `bindRestartPending` / `lanExposureNotice`.

capabilities.name: token-auth
capabilities.description: When `TOKEN` env is set (or the server auto-generates a 32-hex token on first start with no env set), all non-local requests to `/api/*` must include `?token=<value>` or `Authorization: Bearer <value>`. Local requests always bypass. The token can be rotated live from the settings card.

capabilities.name: mobile-responsive
capabilities.description: Layout adapts at <900px (drawer pattern for the sidebar and right panel) and collapses to a single column at <600px. Dark mode follows `prefers-color-system` at boot. Touch targets and font sizes are tuned for phone use.
